base_revenue.note: Total revenue FY2025 ($M) — grew 114% YoY from $60.9B FY2024

revenue_growth.note: 30% near-term — captures FY26/FY27 hyperscaler capex cycle. Was 114% FY25 actual; deceleration begins.

revenue_growth_terminal.note: Y5 fade to 12%. By FY30 revenue ~$300B+ — law of large numbers + AMD/Google/custom-silicon competition forces deceleration. Damodaran: "all hypergrowth fades"

fcff_margin.note: (OCF $64,089M - CapEx $3,236M) / Revenue $130,497M = 46.6%. Software-like margins on hardware due to CUDA moat + AI demand

fcff_margin_terminal.note: 46.6% → 38% over 5yr — COMPRESSION case. AMD MI300, Google TPU, custom silicon (Meta MTIA, AWS Trainium) will pressure pricing. CUDA moat slows decay but doesn't eliminate it.

wacc.note: Sector WACC: Cost of equity 10.72% (Rf 4.18% + β 1.52 × ERP 4.23%) × 97.47% E-weight + after-tax cost of debt 3.97% × 2.53% D-weight

terminal_growth.note: Below long-run US GDP ~2.5%; below Rf 4.18%. NVDA terminal must mean-revert despite current hypergrowth

net_debt.note: Total debt $10,270M - Cash & marketable securities $43,210M = -$32,940M (net cash)

shares_outstanding.note: Diluted weighted-average shares FY2025 ($M shares) — post 10-for-1 split June 2024

buyback_yield.note: $50B authorization June 2024 / ~$3T market cap = ~1% annual. NVDA prioritizes reinvestment over buybacks vs MSFT/META.

sbc_pct_revenue.note: SBC ~$4.7B / Revenue $130B = 3.6%. Looks reasonable in % terms but absolute SBC grew sharply alongside revenue.

expected_output.tolerance_rationale: Extra-wide range — NVDA fundamentally hard to DCF given growth uncertainty. Conservative (g=25%) → ~$75. Aggressive bull (g=35%/margin=50%/WACC=9%) → ~$200. Analyst consensus $280 prices sustained 30%+ growth for a decade + AI dominance moat. Pure 5yr DCF can't capture terminal optionality.
